description: This file defines an interface for accessing application environment statistics, specifically memory usage, within the Orleans framework. It is marked as obsolete, indicating it will be removed in favor of a newer provider interface.

classes.name: IAppEnvironmentStatistics
classes.description: An interface providing access to application environment statistics, such as total memory usage.

methods.name: MemoryUsage
methods.description: A property that returns the total memory usage in bytes, if available.
